author: DJ_Remix
body:
OrigamiJake

Flying

Hello Fellow Admin,
                I let my friend play Minecraft and use my account because he wanted to play. So I am gone for about half an hour and I come back to see that I am banned from my favourite server and started to panic. I go into my internet search history and find that he gave me a hacked client and got me banned for life. I was wondering if I can get un-banned for this one time and delete the hacks. I am sorry for the inconvenience.
                                                                           Sincerely,
                                                                                          OrigamiJake

This is appeal is denied.
